+@dsl_user_op
+def _store_shared_u32x4(address: Int32, packed, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    words = [packed[index].ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for index in range(4)]
+    _asm(
+        None,
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), *words],
+        "st.shared.v4.u32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "r,r,r,r,r",
+        side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _load_shared_u32x4(address: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    loaded = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * 4),
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "ld.shared.v4.u32 {$0, $1, $2, $3}, [$4];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,r",
+        side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    packed = vector.from_elements(
+        ir.VectorType.get([4], T.i32(), loc=loc),
+        [llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), loaded, [k], loc=loc, ip=ip) for k in range(4)],
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return cute.TensorSSA(packed, 4, Uint32)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _dot_bf16x8(a, b, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    """FP32 dot product of two packed BF16x8 fragments, one exact-product FMA
+    per element and no conversions."""
+    a_words = [a[k].ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for k in range(4)]
+    b_words = [b[k].ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for k in range(4)]
+    text = ["{", ".reg .b16 a<8>, b<8>;"]
+    for k in range(4):
+        text.append(f"mov.b32 {{a{2 * k}, a{2 * k + 1}}}, ${1 + k};")
+        text.append(f"mov.b32 {{b{2 * k}, b{2 * k + 1}}}, ${5 + k};")
+    text.append("mov.b32 $0, 0f00000000;")
+    for k in range(VEC_BF16):
+        text.append(f"fma.rn.f32.bf16 $0, a{k}, b{k}, $0;")
+    text.append("}")
+    return Float32(
+        _asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [*a_words, *b_words],
+            "\n\t".join(text),
+            "=f," + ",".join(["r"] * 8),
+            side_effects=False,
+            loc=loc,
+            ip=ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_reduce_scatter(values: list) -> Float32:
+    """Sums 32 per-lane values over the warp; lane ``i`` returns sum ``i``."""
+    lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        width = WARP_SIZE >> (step + 1)
+        upper = (lane & Int32(width)) != Int32(0)
+        kept = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(width):
+            low, high = values[i], values[i + width]
+            sent = Float32(cutlass.select_(upper, low, high))
+            kept.append(
+                Float32(cutlass.select_(upper, high, low))
+                + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                    sent, offset=width, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                )
+            )
+        values = kept
+    return values[0]
+
+
+class _GroupBoundaryDeviceKernel(_BoundaryDeviceKernel):
+    """The boundary for ``tokens`` tokens per cluster, for large batches: one
+    load of the hc_fn rows into registers serves every token of the cluster,
+    the residual streams are staged in shared memory before the PDL wait, and
+    the tokens share the two cluster reductions."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, tokens: int, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        if self.values > WARP_SIZE:
+            raise ValueError("the mixes must fit one warp reduce-scatter")
+        self.tokens = tokens
+        # Per token: post-mix and residual mix, then the reductions.
+        self.inputs = HC + HC * HC
+
+    def smem_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
+        staged = self.tokens * HC * self.groups_per_cta * 16
+        floats = self.tokens * (
+            self.inputs
+            + (self.warps + self.cluster_size + 1) * self.values
+            + self.warps
+            + self.cluster_size
+        )
+        return staged + floats * 4
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mailbox: cute.Tensor,
+        residual: cute.Tensor,
+        post: cute.Tensor,
+        comb: cute.Tensor,
+        fn: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cute.Tensor,
+        gamma: cute.Tensor,
+        residual_output: cute.Tensor,
+        mixes_output: cute.Tensor,
+        norm_output: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(
+            mailbox,
+            residual,
+            post,
+            comb,
+            fn,
+            scale,
+            base,
+            gamma,
+            residual_output,
+            mixes_output,
+            norm_output,
+            stage_state,
+            m,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=((m + self.tokens - 1) // self.tokens, self.cluster_size, 1),
+            block=(self.threads, 1, 1),
+            cluster=(1, self.cluster_size, 1),
+            smem=self.smem_size_in_bytes(),
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=True,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mailbox: cute.Tensor,
+        residual: cute.Tensor,
+        post: cute.Tensor,
+        comb: cute.Tensor,
+        fn: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cute.Tensor,
+        gamma: cute.Tensor,
+        residual_output: cute.Tensor,
+        mixes_output: cute.Tensor,
+        norm_output: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        m: Int32,
+    ) -> None:
+        hidden = self.hidden
+        tokens = self.tokens
+        values = self.values
+        cluster = self.cluster_size
+        groups = self.groups_per_cta
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        group, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        cluster_rank = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.block_idx_in_cluster())
+        warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+        lane = tidx % HC  # source rank while polling, hc stream afterwards
+        local = tidx // HC
+        fragment = cluster_rank * groups + local
+        column = Int64(fragment) * VEC_BF16
+        first = group * tokens
+        # A short last group repeats its last token; the repeats rewrite the
+        # same outputs.
+        last = m - 1
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        staged = smem.allocate_array(
+            Uint32, tokens * HC * groups * 4, byte_alignment=16
+        )
+        mix_inputs = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * self.inputs)
+        warp_sums = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * self.warps * values)
+        cluster_sums = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * cluster * values)
+        totals = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * values)
+        warp_sums2 = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * self.warps)
+        cluster_sums2 = smem.allocate_array(Float32, tokens * cluster)
+
+        # Everything below until the PDL wait is a weight or was written before
+        # the publish kernel's producer started.
+        fn_rows = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+            cute.make_layout((MIX, 4), stride=(4, 1)), Uint32
+        )
+        for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(MIX):
+            element = Int64(row) * (HC * hidden) + Int64(lane) * hidden + column
+            fn_rows[row, None].store(load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(fn, element, 16)))
+        gamma_values = packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(
+            load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(gamma, column, 16))
+        )
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            token = cutlass.min(first + t, last)
+            element = (Int64(token) * HC + Int64(lane)) * hidden + column
+            _store_shared_u32x4(
+                (staged + ((t * HC + lane) * groups + local) * 4).toint(),
+                load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(residual, element, 16)),
+            )
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            (tokens * self.inputs + self.threads - 1) // self.threads
+        ):
+            index = tidx + k * self.threads
+            if index < Int32(tokens * self.inputs):
+                t = index // self.inputs
+                j = index % self.inputs
+                row = Int64(cutlass.min(first + t, last))
+                if j < Int32(HC):
+                    value = cute.arch.load(
+                        (post.iterator + row * HC + Int64(j)).llvm_ptr, Float32
+                    )
+                    cute.arch.store((mix_inputs + index).llvm_ptr, value)
+                else:
+                    value = cute.arch.load(
+                        (comb.iterator + row * (HC * HC) + Int64(j - HC)).llvm_ptr,
+                        Float32,
+                    )
+                    cute.arch.store((mix_inputs + index).llvm_ptr, value)
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+
+        # Poll every token at once: a repeated token reads its slot again
+        # before the reset below.
+        active_stage = load_volatile_u32(stage_state.iterator + ACTIVE_STAGE)
+        stage_base = Int64(active_stage) * self.tp + Int64(lane)
+        kept = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+            cute.make_layout((tokens, 4), stride=(4, 1)), Uint32
+        )
+        dirty = True
+        while dirty:
+            dirty = False
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+                token = cutlass.min(first + t, last)
+                slot = (stage_base * self.capacity_m + Int64(token)) * hidden + column
+                loaded = load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(mailbox, slot, 16), volatile=True)
+                dirty = dirty | fragment_has_negative_zero(loaded)
+                kept[t, None].store(loaded)
+        # Lanes leave the poll at different times; without reconverging, every
+        # shuffle below takes the divergent-warp path.
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+        reduced = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((VEC_BF16,)), Float32)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            reduced.store(packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(kept[t, None].load()).to(Float32))
+            for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(VEC_BF16):
+                    reduced[k] = reduced[k] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                        reduced[k], offset=1 << offset, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                    )
+            # The all-reduced sublayer output is BF16, as the collective
+            # returns it.
+            kept[t, None].store(bf16x8_to_packed_u32x4(reduced.load().to(BFloat16)))
+
+        if group == 0 and cluster_rank == 0 and tidx == 0:
+            store_global_u32(
+                stage_state.iterator + NEXT_STAGE,
+                (active_stage + Uint32(1)) % Uint32(LAMPORT_GENERATIONS),
+            )
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            token = cutlass.min(first + t, last)
+            slot = (stage_base * self.capacity_m + Int64(token)) * hidden + column
+            store_lamport_sentinel_u32x4(Int64((mailbox.iterator + slot).toint()))
+
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            token = cutlass.min(first + t, last)
+            inputs = mix_inputs + t * self.inputs
+            mixed = packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(kept[t, None].load()).to(
+                Float32
+            ) * cute.arch.load((inputs + lane).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+            for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                stream = packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(
+                    _load_shared_u32x4(
+                        (staged + ((t * HC + source) * groups + local) * 4).toint()
+                    )
+                )
+                mixed = mixed + stream.to(Float32) * cute.arch.load(
+                    (inputs + HC + source * HC + lane).llvm_ptr, Float32
+                )
+            stream_bf16 = mixed.to(BFloat16)
+            words = bf16x8_to_packed_u32x4(stream_bf16)
+            kept[t, None].store(words)
+            output = (Int64(token) * HC + Int64(lane)) * hidden + column
+            store_global_u32x4(
+                Int64((residual_output.iterator + output).toint()), words
+            )
+            partial = [
+                _dot_bf16x8(fn_rows[row, None].load(), words) for row in range(MIX)
+            ]
+            partial.append(_dot_bf16x8(words, words))
+            for _ in cutlass.range_constexpr(WARP_SIZE - values):
+                partial.append(Float32(0.0))
+            total = _warp_reduce_scatter(partial)
+            if cute.arch.lane_idx() < Int32(values):
+                cute.arch.store(
+                    (
+                        warp_sums
+                        + (t * self.warps + warp) * values
+                        + cute.arch.lane_idx()
+                    ).llvm_ptr,
+                    total,
+                )
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        # Every CTA's per-token sums into every peer's slot, then the totals.
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            (tokens * values + self.threads - 1) // self.threads
+        ):
+            index = tidx + k * self.threads
+            if index < Int32(tokens * values):
+                t = index // values
+                v = index % values
+                total = Float32(0.0)
+                for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.warps):
+                    total = total + cute.arch.load(
+                        (warp_sums + (t * self.warps + w) * values + v).llvm_ptr,
+                        Float32,
+                    )
+                for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(cluster):
+                    remote = map_shared_to_peer(
+                        cluster_sums + (t * cluster + cluster_rank) * values + v,
+                        Int32(peer),
+                    )
+                    store_shared_cluster_f32(remote, total)
+        cute.arch.cluster_arrive()
+        cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            (tokens * values + self.threads - 1) // self.threads
+        ):
+            index = tidx + k * self.threads
+            if index < Int32(tokens * values):
+                t = index // values
+                v = index % values
+                total = Float32(0.0)
+                for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(cluster):
+                    total = total + cute.arch.load(
+                        (cluster_sums + (t * cluster + peer) * values + v).llvm_ptr,
+                        Float32,
+                    )
+                cute.arch.store((totals + index).llvm_ptr, total)
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        scale_pre = cute.arch.load(scale.iterator.llvm_ptr, Float32)
+        base_pre = cute.arch.load((base.iterator + lane).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+        squares = []
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            rstd = cute.math.rsqrt(
+                cute.arch.load((totals + t * values + MIX).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+                / Float32(HC * hidden)
+                + Float32(self.rms_eps)
+            )
+            if cluster_rank == 0 and tidx < Int32(MIX) and first + t <= last:
+                cute.arch.store(
+                    (
+                        mixes_output.iterator + Int64(first + t) * MIX + Int64(tidx)
+                    ).llvm_ptr,
+                    cute.arch.load((totals + t * values + tidx).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+                    * rstd,
+                )
+            mix = cute.arch.load((totals + t * values + lane).llvm_ptr, Float32) * rstd
+            pre_mix = _sigmoid(mix * scale_pre + base_pre) + Float32(self.pre_eps)
+            collapse = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((VEC_BF16,)), Float32)
+            collapse.store(
+                packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(kept[t, None].load()).to(Float32) * pre_mix
+            )
+            for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(VEC_BF16):
+                    collapse[k] = collapse[k] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                        collapse[k], offset=1 << offset, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                    )
+            prenorm = collapse.load().to(BFloat16)
+            kept[t, None].store(bf16x8_to_packed_u32x4(prenorm))
+            square = (prenorm.to(Float32) * prenorm.to(Float32)).reduce(
+                cute.ReductionOp.ADD, init_val=Float32(0.0), reduction_profile=0
+            )
+            squares.append(
+                Float32(cutlass.select_(lane == Int32(0), square, Float32(0.0)))
+            )
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+            for offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+                squares[t] = squares[t] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                    squares[t], offset=1 << offset, mask=-1, mask_and_clamp=31
+                )
+        if cute.arch.lane_idx() == 0:
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+                cute.arch.store(
+                    (warp_sums2 + t * self.warps + warp).llvm_ptr, squares[t]
+                )
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        if tidx < Int32(tokens * cluster):
+            t = tidx // cluster
+            peer = tidx % cluster
+            total = Float32(0.0)
+            for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.warps):
+                total = total + cute.arch.load(
+                    (warp_sums2 + t * self.warps + w).llvm_ptr, Float32
+                )
+            remote = map_shared_to_peer(
+                cluster_sums2 + t * cluster + cluster_rank, peer
+            )
+            store_shared_cluster_f32(remote, total)
+        cute.arch.cluster_arrive()
+        cute.arch.cluster_wait()
+
+        if lane == 0:
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(tokens):
+                token = cutlass.min(first + t, last)
+                sum_square = Float32(0.0)
+                for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(cluster):
+                    sum_square = sum_square + cute.arch.load(
+                        (cluster_sums2 + t * cluster + peer).llvm_ptr, Float32
+                    )
+                inv_rms = cute.math.rsqrt(
+                    sum_square / Float32(hidden) + Float32(self.norm_eps)
+                )
+                normed = packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(kept[t, None].load()).to(Float32)
+                result = (normed * inv_rms * gamma_values.to(Float32)).to(BFloat16)
+                store_global_u32x4(
+                    Int64(
+                        (norm_output.iterator + Int64(token) * hidden + column).toint()
+                    ),
+                    bf16x8_to_packed_u32x4(result),
+                )
+

+class _MixesDeviceKernel:
+    """One thread per token: the post-mix and the Sinkhorn residual mix from a
+    boundary's raw mixes."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, sinkhorn_eps: float, post_mult: float, repeat: int, capacity_m: int
+    ):
+        self.sinkhorn_eps = sinkhorn_eps
+        self.post_mult = post_mult
+        self.repeat = repeat
+        self.threads = -(-capacity_m // WARP_SIZE) * WARP_SIZE
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mixes: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cute.Tensor,
+        post: cute.Tensor,
+        comb: cute.Tensor,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(mixes, scale, base, post, comb, m).launch(
+            grid=(1, 1, 1), block=(self.threads, 1, 1), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mixes: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor,
+        base: cute.Tensor,
+        post: cute.Tensor,
+        comb: cute.Tensor,
+        m: Int32,
+    ) -> None:
+        token, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        if token < m:
+            row = mixes.iterator + Int64(token) * MIX
+            post_scale = cute.arch.load((scale.iterator + 1).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                value = _sigmoid(
+                    cute.arch.load((row + HC + j).llvm_ptr, Float32) * post_scale
+                    + cute.arch.load((base.iterator + HC + j).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+                ) * Float32(self.post_mult)
+                cute.arch.store((post.iterator + Int64(token) * HC + j).llvm_ptr, value)
+            c = self._sinkhorn(row, scale, base)
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC * HC):
+                cute.arch.store(
+                    (comb.iterator + Int64(token) * HC * HC + k).llvm_ptr, c[k]
+                )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _sinkhorn(self, row: cute.Pointer, scale: cute.Tensor, base: cute.Tensor):
+        """The residual mix, row-major in 16 registers."""
+        eps = Float32(self.sinkhorn_eps)
+        comb_scale = cute.arch.load((scale.iterator + 2).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+        c = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC * HC):
+            mix = cute.arch.load((row + 2 * HC + i).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+            bias = cute.arch.load((base.iterator + 2 * HC + i).llvm_ptr, Float32)
+            c.append(mix * comb_scale + bias)
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+            i = r * HC
+            peak = cute.arch.fmax(
+                cute.arch.fmax(c[i], c[i + 1]), cute.arch.fmax(c[i + 2], c[i + 3])
+            )
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                c[i + k] = cute.math.exp(c[i + k] - peak)
+            inv = _rcp((c[i] + c[i + 1]) + (c[i + 2] + c[i + 3]))
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                c[i + k] = c[i + k] * inv + eps
+        for iteration in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.repeat):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(iteration > 0):
+                for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                    i = r * HC
+                    inv = _rcp((c[i] + c[i + 1]) + (c[i + 2] + c[i + 3]) + eps)
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                        c[i + k] = c[i + k] * inv
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                inv = _rcp((c[k] + c[HC + k]) + (c[2 * HC + k] + c[3 * HC + k]) + eps)
+                for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(HC):
+                    c[r * HC + k] = c[r * HC + k] * inv
+        return c
+

+class AllReduceMhcBoundary:
+    """``tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce`` + ``hc_fused_post_pre`` for up to
+    ``max_num_tokens`` tokens: two kernels on the current stream and one on a
+    side stream.
+
+    The returned post-mix and residual mix are written on the side stream; the
+    next call joins it, and a stock consumer must call ``join`` first.
+    Construction is collective over the TP group; one instance serves every
+    boundary of the model, which run one after another. ``cluster_tokens``
+    maps a token count to the tokens each cluster takes (1 if absent).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+        rms_eps: float,
+        hc_eps: float,
+        post_mult: float,
+        sinkhorn_repeat: int,
+        norm_eps: float,
+        device: torch.device,
+        top_k: int,
+        cluster_size: int = 8,
+        cluster_tokens: Mapping[int, int] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        group = get_tp_group().device_group
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.hidden_size = hidden = hidden_size
+        self.capacity = capacity = max_num_tokens
+        tp = dist.get_world_size(group)
+        rank = dist.get_rank(group)
+        device = torch.device(device)
+
+        def dynamic(dtype, alignment, divisibility):
+            return make_fake_dynamic_compact_tensor(
+                dtype, alignment=alignment, divisibility=divisibility
+            )
+
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(device.index):
+            self._publish = cute.compile(
+                _PublishDeviceKernel(
+                    hidden=hidden, tp=tp, rank=rank, capacity_m=capacity
+                ),
+                dynamic(BFloat16, 16, hidden),
+                make_fake_compact_tensor(Int32, (2,), assumed_align=4),
+                Int64(0),
+                Int32(capacity),
+                current_cu_stream(),
+            )
+            # By routing-weight dtype; the routing folds in the routed scale.
+            self._finalize_publish = {
+                dtype: cute.compile(
+                    _QuadFinalizePublishDeviceKernel(
+                        hidden=hidden,
+                        top_k=top_k,
+                        tp=tp,
+                        rank=rank,
+                        capacity_m=capacity,
+                        threads=128,
+                        routed_scaling_factor=1.0,
+                        include_shared_expert=True,
+                        load_shared_expert_before_pdl=False,
+                        enable_pdl=True,
+                        prefetch_group=top_k,
+                        fp32_weights=dtype == torch.float32,
+                    ),
+                    dynamic(BFloat16, 16, hidden),
+                    dynamic(
+                        Float32 if dtype == torch.float32 else BFloat16,
+                        4 if dtype == torch.float32 else 2,
+                        top_k,
+                    ),
+                    dynamic(Int32, 4, top_k),
+                    dynamic(BFloat16, 16, hidden),
+                    make_fake_compact_tensor(Int32, (2,), assumed_align=4),
+                    Int64(0),
+                    Int32(capacity),
+                    current_cu_stream(),
+                )
+                for dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)
+            }
+            boundary = dict(
+                hidden=hidden,
+                tp=tp,
+                capacity_m=capacity,
+                cluster_size=cluster_size,
+                rms_eps=rms_eps,
+                pre_eps=hc_eps,
+                norm_eps=norm_eps,
+            )
+            self.cluster_tokens = dict(cluster_tokens or {})
+            self._boundary = {}
+            for tokens in {1, *self.cluster_tokens.values()}:
+                kernel = (
+                    _GroupBoundaryDeviceKernel(tokens=tokens, **boundary)
+                    if tokens > 1
+                    else _BoundaryDeviceKernel(**boundary)
+                )
+                self._boundary[tokens] = cute.compile(
+                    kernel,
+                    make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                        BFloat16,
+                        (LAMPORT_GENERATIONS * tp * capacity * hidden,),
+                        assumed_align=16,
+                    ),
+                    dynamic(BFloat16, 16, HC * hidden),
+                    dynamic(Float32, 4, HC),
+                    dynamic(Float32, 4, HC * HC),
+                    make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                        BFloat16, (MIX * HC * hidden,), assumed_align=16
+                    ),
+                    make_fake_compact_tensor(Float32, (3,), assumed_align=4),

+The boundary of the MTP draft layer, which has no mHC streams: the sublayer's
+partial output (or its MoE output, top-k reduction still open) is multicast
+into a Lamport mailbox by ``all_reduce_mhc``'s publish kernels, then one CTA
+per token polls every rank's contribution, sums it, adds the residual and
+RMS-normalizes the sum.
+
+The draft's input takes the same mailbox: each rank publishes its vocabulary
+shard's embedding rows (zeros for tokens it does not own), and the norm kernel

+class _EmbedPublishDeviceKernel:
+    """Multicasts this rank's embedding rows of ``ids`` (zeros for ids outside
+    its ``[start, start + rows)`` shard) into the Lamport mailbox."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, hidden: int, tp: int, rank: int, capacity_m: int, start: int, rows: int
+    ):
+        self.hidden = hidden
+        self.tp = tp
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.capacity_m = capacity_m
+        self.start = start
+        self.rows = rows
+        self.threads = 128
+        self.ctas_per_token = hidden // VEC_BF16 // self.threads
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        ids: cute.Tensor,
+        weight: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        multicast: Int64,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(ids, weight, stage_state, multicast).launch(
+            grid=(m * self.ctas_per_token, 1, 1),
+            block=(self.threads, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+            use_pdl=True,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        ids: cute.Tensor,
+        weight: cute.Tensor,
+        stage_state: cute.Tensor,
+        multicast: Int64,
+    ):
+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        token = block // self.ctas_per_token
+        column = Int64((block % self.ctas_per_token) * self.threads + tidx) * VEC_BF16
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        row = Int64(ids[token]) - self.start
+        words = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((4,)), Uint32)
+        words.fill(Uint32(0))
+        if (row >= 0) & (row < self.rows):
+            words.store(
+                sanitize_negative_zero_u32x4(
+                    load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(weight, row * self.hidden + column, 16))
+                )
+            )
+        stage = load_volatile_u32(stage_state.iterator + NEXT_STAGE)
+        slot = (
+            (Int64(stage) * self.tp + self.rank) * self.capacity_m + Int64(token)
+        ) * self.hidden + column
+        stmc_bf16x8(multicast + slot * 2, words.load())
+        if block == 0 and tidx == 0:
+            store_global_u32(stage_state.iterator + ACTIVE_STAGE, stage)

+class _EmbedNormDeviceKernel:
+    """One CTA per token: sums the published embedding, zeroes it at position

+
+    def __init__(self, *, hidden: int, tp: int, capacity_m: int, eps: float):

+            load_global_u32x4(_gmem_ptr(previous, element, 16))

+        reduced.fill(0.0)
+        packed = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((4,)), Uint32)

+                + Int64(token)

+                dirty = fragment_has_negative_zero(loaded)
+                packed.store(loaded)

+                reduced.load() + packed_u32x4_to_bf16x8(packed.load()).to(Float32)

+            cute.ReductionOp.ADD, init_val=Float32(0.0), reduction_profile=0

+"""The dense (first ``first_k_dense_replace``) layers' MLP of a few decode tokens
+as two CuTe kernels, in place of input quant, DeepGEMM gate_up, SwiGLU, quant and
+DeepGEMM down.
+
+A CTA owns a few 16-row tiles over the whole K, one warp per (tile, 512 of K):
+one m16n8k32 FP8 mma.sync per 32 K with the tokens as the eight B columns. A lane
+always reads the same 16 bytes of a row (and of a token), so its A and B
+fragments come from plain 16-byte loads: within each 64-K step lane (g, q) holds
+K 16q..16q+15 of rows g and g + 8, and the two mmas of the step take its first
+and last eight bytes. Any K order is fine as long as A and B agree.
+
+The CTA's weights stream into shared memory (cp.async, L2 evict-first) and,
+for the first ``in_regs`` steps, into registers before the PDL wait, so a whole
+layer's weights are in flight at launch. After the wait the tiles' warps of a K
+slice split its tokens and quantize them once for the CTA (FP8 per 128 with the
+stock scale rule): every CTA reads and quantizes the whole input, so fewer,
+larger CTAs (one per SM) keep that from growing with the tokens. Each 128-K
+group's four mmas sum in FP32 and take the weight and activation scales, and the
+warps' partial sums meet in shared memory.
+
+The gate_up CTA owns gate rows 8c..8c+7 (A rows g) and the matching up rows
+(A rows g + 8), so its epilogue writes the clamped SwiGLU directly, rounding
+like stock: BF16 gate/up, then a BF16 product. The down kernel's input is that
+BF16 activation.

+    """BF16 [tokens, rows] = FP8-quantized BF16 [tokens, k] input times the FP8
+    [rows, k] weight; with ``swiglu`` the clamped SwiGLU [tokens, rows / 2] of the
+    gate (first half) and up (second half) rows."""

+    def __init__(

+        ctas_per_sm: int, swiglu: bool, limit: float, ue8m0: bool,
+    ):  # fmt: skip

+        self.ctas = rows // (16 * tiles)
+        self.staged = STEPS - in_regs

+        self.weight_words = self.warps * self.staged * 2 * 32 * 4

+    def _summed(self, partial, src, i):
+        """Partial sum ``i`` of lane ``src``, over the tile's warps."""

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Greedy draft tokens from vocab-parallel logits in one kernel.
+
+One CTA per token scans this rank's logits shard for its first maximum, packs it
+into a 64-bit key (order-preserving value bits, then the complement of the
+global index, so the larger key is the larger value and, on ties, the lower
+index) and multicasts the key into every rank's mailbox. Each rank then polls
+the TP keys and keeps the largest: the token ``argmax`` of the all-gathered
+logits picks, without gathering them.
+
+A mailbox word is never zero while published (the low word is the index
+complement), so zero is the empty sentinel; each half is written once per use
+and reset by its reader, and two generations per token slot keep a rank one
+call ahead from overwriting a key its peers have not read.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_compact_tensor
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.cute_dsl.primitives import (
+    WARP_SIZE,
+    current_cu_stream,
+    make_fake_dynamic_compact_tensor,
+    to_cute,
+    to_cute_dynamic,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.primitives import (
+    float_bits,
+    load_bf16x8,
+    load_words,
+    multicast_words,
+    redux,
+    store_words,
+)
+
+THREADS = 1024
+VEC = 8
+GENERATIONS = 2
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ordered(value):
+    """Unsigned bits whose order is the float order."""
+    bits = Uint32(float_bits(value))
+    flip = Uint32(0x80000000)
+    if bits >= Uint32(0x80000000):
+        flip = Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF)
+    return bits ^ flip
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_max(high, low):
+    """Lexicographic warp maximum of (high, low)."""
+    top = redux(high, "max")
+    candidate = Uint32(0)
+    if high == top:
+        candidate = low
+    return top, redux(candidate, "max")
+
+
+class _ArgmaxKernel:
+    def __init__(self, *, columns: int, valid: int, offset: int, tp: int, rank: int,
+                 capacity: int):  # fmt: skip
+        if columns % VEC:
+            raise ValueError("the logits shard must hold whole 8-column vectors")
+        self.columns, self.valid, self.offset = columns, valid, offset
+        self.tp, self.rank, self.capacity = tp, rank, capacity
+        self.warps = THREADS // WARP_SIZE
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        logits: cute.Tensor,
+        mailbox: cute.Tensor,
+        multicast: Int64,
+        epoch: cute.Tensor,
+        tokens: cute.Tensor,
+        m: Int32,
+        stream,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.kernel(logits, mailbox, multicast, epoch, tokens).launch(
+            grid=(m, 1, 1),
+            block=(THREADS, 1, 1),
+            smem=self.warps * 8,
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        logits: cute.Tensor,
+        mailbox: cute.Tensor,
+        multicast: Int64,
+        epoch: cute.Tensor,
+        tokens: cute.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        token, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+        row = logits.iterator + Int64(token) * self.columns
+
+        best = Uint32(0)
+        index = Int32(0)
+        vectors = self.columns // VEC
+        rounds = (vectors + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
+        # A thread issues all of its loads before the compares; the last round's
+        # out-of-range vectors reread the last one and fail the column mask.
+        loaded = []
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(rounds):
+            vector = tidx + r * THREADS
+            if r == rounds - 1 and vectors % THREADS:
+                vector = cutlass.min(vector, vectors - 1)
+            loaded.append(load_bf16x8(row + vector * VEC))
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(rounds):
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(VEC):
+                key = _ordered(loaded[r][k])
+                column = (tidx + r * THREADS) * VEC + k
+                if key > best:  # noqa: SIM102 (one dynamic test per if)
+                    if column < self.valid:
+                        best = key
+                        index = column
+        high, low = _warp_max(best, Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF) - Uint32(index + self.offset))
+
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        highs = smem.allocate_array(Uint32, self.warps)
+        lows = smem.allocate_array(Uint32, self.warps)
+        if lane == 0:
+            cute.arch.store((highs + warp).llvm_ptr, high)
+            cute.arch.store((lows + warp).llvm_ptr, low)
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        if warp == 0:
+            high = cute.arch.load((highs + lane).llvm_ptr, Uint32)
+            low = cute.arch.load((lows + lane).llvm_ptr, Uint32)
+            high, low = _warp_max(high, low)
+            if lane == 0:
+                use = epoch[token]
+                generation = Int64(use % GENERATIONS)
+                own = ((generation * self.tp + self.rank) * self.capacity + token) * 2
+                multicast_words(multicast + own * 4, (high, low), kind="f32")
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tp):
+                    element = (
+                        (generation * self.tp + source) * self.capacity + Int64(token)
+                    ) * 2
+                    slot = mailbox.iterator + element
+                    peer_high = Uint32(0)
+                    peer_low = Uint32(0)
+                    empty = True
+                    while empty:
+                        peer_high, peer_low = load_words(
+                            slot, count=2, volatile=True, word_type="u32"
+                        )
+                        empty = peer_high == Uint32(0)
+                        if peer_low == Uint32(0):
+                            empty = True
+                    store_words(slot, (Uint32(0), Uint32(0)))
+                    if peer_high > high:
+                        high = peer_high
+                        low = peer_low
+                    if peer_high == high:  # noqa: SIM102 (one dynamic test per if)
+                        if peer_low > low:
+                            low = peer_low
+                epoch[token] = use + 1
+                tokens[token] = Int64(Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF) - low)
+
+
+class DraftArgmax:
+    """``argmax(all_gather(logits))`` of [M, vocab shard] BF16 logits, M <= capacity.
+
+    Construction is collective over the TP group.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *, columns: int, valid: int, offset: int, capacity: int,
+                 device: torch.device):  # fmt: skip
+        group = get_tp_group().device_group
+        tp = dist.get_world_size(group)
+        rank = dist.get_rank(group)
+        self.capacity = capacity
+        device = torch.device(device)
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(device.index):
+            self._kernel = cute.compile(
+                _ArgmaxKernel(
+                    columns=columns,
+                    valid=valid,
+                    offset=offset,
+                    tp=tp,
+                    rank=rank,
+                    capacity=capacity,
+                ),  # fmt: skip
+                make_fake_dynamic_compact_tensor(
+                    BFloat16, alignment=16, divisibility=columns
+                ),
+                make_fake_compact_tensor(
+                    Int32, (GENERATIONS * tp * capacity * 2,), assumed_align=16
+                ),
+                Int64(0),
+                make_fake_compact_tensor(Int32, (capacity,), assumed_align=4),
+                make_fake_dynamic_compact_tensor(Int64, alignment=8, divisibility=1),
+                Int32(capacity),
+                current_cu_stream(),
+            )
+            self._mailbox = symm_mem.empty(
+                (GENERATIONS, tp, capacity, 2), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            )
+            handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(self._mailbox, group)
+            multicast = int(handle.multicast_ptr or 0)
+            if not multicast or multicast % 16:
+                raise RuntimeError("NVLink multicast mapping is unavailable")
+            self._handle = handle
+            self._multicast = multicast
+            self._mailbox.zero_()
+            self._epoch = torch.zeros(capacity, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        dist.barrier(group=group)
+
+    def supports(self, tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return 1 <= tokens <= self.capacity
+
+    def __call__(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        m = logits.shape[0]
+        tokens = torch.empty(m, dtype=torch.int64, device=logits.device)
+        self._kernel(
+            to_cute_dynamic(logits.flatten(), 16, divisibility=logits.shape[1]),
+            to_cute(self._mailbox.flatten(), 16),
+            Int64(self._multicast),
+            to_cute(self._epoch, 4),
+            to_cute_dynamic(tokens, 8, divisibility=1),
+            Int32(m),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        return tokens

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DSA attention stage (``dsa_attn``): the MLA half of the DSA layer around the
+indexer and the TRTLLM-Gen sparse attention kernel, in CuTe kernels.
+
+Stock decode runs the q/kv a-norm (Triton), then after the indexer's top-k the
+MLA KV cache write, the cuBLAS absorb bmm (query x W_UK), the query FP8 quant
+and a zero fill of the attention kernel's multi-CTA counters, all between the
+top-k and the attention, then the cuBLAS W_UV bmm. Here:
+
+- ``norm`` is ``fused_q_kv_rmsnorm`` in CuTe;
+- ``head_gemv`` with ``cache`` is the absorb bmm with the static FP8 query quant
+  as its epilogue, and M more CTAs write the normed latent into the FP8 KV cache
+  (``concat_and_cache_mla``). It runs right after ``q_b_proj``, before the
+  indexer, so only the index remap separates the top-k from the attention;
+- the attention kernel gets one caller-owned counter buffer (it resets the
+  counters itself), so FlashInfer zero-fills none per call;
+- ``head_gemv`` is the W_UV bmm (and, for the KDA stage, the output gate's
+  g_b_proj).
+
+The bmms are per-head ``x @ W`` products with W row-major [I, J]: a thread
+holds RPT rows of eight consecutive columns, loaded before the PDL wait, and
+the row groups are summed across lanes and warps in a fixed order. Their FP32
+sums differ from cuBLAS's only in summation order; the BF16 rounding and the
+FP8 conversions follow the stock kernels.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+    stream,
+    to_cute,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.primitives import (
+    alloc,
+    asm,
+    bf16x2,
+    div_rn,
+    fp8_bits,
+    load_vector,
+    load_words,
+    pack_fp8,
+    store_words,
+    unpack_bf16,
+    warp_sum,
+)
+
+from .mega_moe import _store_bf16
+from .shared_expert import _round_bf16
+
+FP8_MAX = 448.0
+MAX_TOKENS = 8  # FP32 accumulators per thread: 8 columns x tokens
+
+_compiled: dict = {}
+
+
+@asm(Float32, pure=True)
+def _div_full(a, b):
+    """Triton's FP32 ``/``."""
+    return "div.full.f32 $0,$1,$2;", "=f,f,f", (a, b)
+
+
+@asm(Float32, pure=True)
+def _rsqrt(value):
+    """Triton's ``tl.rsqrt``."""
+    return "rsqrt.approx.f32 $0,$1;", "=f,f", (value,)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _clamp_fp8(value: Float32):
+    """``scaled_fp8_conversion``'s clamp before the saturating conversion."""
+    return cute.arch.fmax(cute.arch.fmin(value, Float32(FP8_MAX)), Float32(-FP8_MAX))
+
+
+class _NormKernel:
+    """``fused_q_kv_rmsnorm`` of the a-projection's q and kv parts (CTA (t, 0)
+    and (t, 1)). A thread owns eight values; the sum of squares adds the
+    thread's, then the lanes' and then the warps' partials."""
+
+    def __init__(self, q_size: int, kv_size: int, pitch: int):
+        assert q_size % 8 == 0 and kv_size % 8 == 0 and q_size >= kv_size
+        self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.pitch = q_size, kv_size, pitch
+        self.threads = (q_size // 8 + 31) // 32 * 32
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self, qkv: cute.Tensor, q_w: cute.Tensor, kv_w: cute.Tensor,
+        q_out: cute.Tensor, kv_out: cute.Tensor, eps: Float32, tokens: Int32,
+        st: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        self.kernel(qkv, q_w, kv_w, q_out, kv_out, eps).launch(
+            grid=(tokens, 2, 1), block=(self.threads, 1, 1), stream=st, use_pdl=True
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self, qkv: cute.Tensor, q_w: cute.Tensor, kv_w: cute.Tensor,
+        q_out: cute.Tensor, kv_out: cute.Tensor, eps: Float32,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        t, part, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        partial = alloc(smem, Float32, (self.threads // 32,))
+        if part == 0:
+            self.row(qkv, q_w, q_out, partial, t, tid, 0, self.q_size, eps)
+        else:
+            self.row(qkv, kv_w, kv_out, partial, t, tid, self.q_size, self.kv_size, eps)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def row(
+        self, qkv, weight, out, partial, t, tid, start, size: cutlass.Constexpr, eps
+    ):
+        """The thread's eight columns of the ``size``-wide part at ``start``."""
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        warp = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+        active = tid < size // 8
+        gamma = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((8,)), Float32)
+        gamma.fill(0.0)
+        if active:
+            got = load_words(weight.iterator + tid * 8, count=4, word_type="u32")
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                gamma[2 * i], gamma[2 * i + 1] = unpack_bf16(got[i])
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        # Dependents read the outputs only after their own wait.
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        x = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((8,)), Float32)
+        x.fill(0.0)
+        if active:
+            got = load_words(
+                qkv.iterator + t * self.pitch + start + tid * 8,
+                count=4, word_type="u32", mutable=True,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                x[2 * i], x[2 * i + 1] = unpack_bf16(got[i])
+        squares = Float32(0.0)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            squares = squares + x[i] * x[i]
+        squares = warp_sum(squares)
+        if lane == 0:
+            partial[warp] = squares
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        total = Float32(0.0)
+        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.threads // 32):
+            total = total + partial[w]
+        rrms = _rsqrt(_div_full(total, Float32(size)) + eps)
+        if active:
+            y = [x[i] * rrms * gamma[i] for i in range(8)]
+            words = [bf16x2(y[2 * i], y[2 * i + 1]) for i in range(4)]
+            store_words(out.iterator + t * size + tid * 8, words)
+
+
+def norm(qkv, q_weight, kv_weight, eps, q_size):
+    """``fused_q_kv_rmsnorm(qkv[:, :q_size], qkv[:, q_size:], ...)``: the normed
+    (q [M, q_size], kv [M, kv_size]) BF16 parts of ``qkv``."""
+    m, pitch = qkv.shape
+    kv_size = kv_weight.shape[0]
+    assert qkv.stride(1) == 1 and qkv.stride(0) == pitch
+    assert pitch == q_size + kv_size
+    q_out = torch.empty((m, q_size), dtype=qkv.dtype, device=qkv.device)
+    kv_out = torch.empty((m, kv_size), dtype=qkv.dtype, device=qkv.device)
+    args = (qkv, q_weight, kv_weight, q_out, kv_out)
+    st = stream(qkv.device)
+    key = ("norm", m, q_size, kv_size, qkv.device.index)
+    if key not in _compiled:
+        _compiled[key] = cute.compile(
+            _NormKernel(q_size, kv_size, pitch),
+            *(to_cute(t, 16) for t in args), Float32(eps), Int32(m), st,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+    _compiled[key](*(to_cute(t, 16) for t in args), Float32(eps), Int32(m), st)
+    return q_out, kv_out
+
+
+class _HeadGemvKernel:
+    """``out[t, h] = x[t, h] @ W[h]`` for ``heads`` row-major [I, J] weights.
+
+    CTA (h, tile) owns J columns ``tile * cols ...``; thread (g, c) holds rows
+    ``g * rpt ...`` of columns ``8c ...``, loaded before the PDL wait. Lanes of
+    one column group sum their row groups with butterflies, then the warps' sums
+    add in warp order. ``fp8``: the BF16 product times the inverse of
+    ``scale[0]``, clamped and converted as the stock static FP8 quant.
+
+    ``cache`` (latent width): CTA ``gemv CTAs + t`` writes token t's latent row
+    into the FP8 KV cache as ``concat_and_cache_mla`` (``kv / k_scale``, padded
+    slots skipped).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, heads, rows, cols, tile, rpt, tokens, w_strides, fp8, cache=0,
+        x_stride=None,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        assert tile % 8 == 0 and cols % tile == 0 and rows % rpt == 0 and rpt % 8 == 0
+        self.heads, self.rows, self.cols, self.tile, self.rpt = (
+            heads, rows, cols, tile, rpt,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+        self.tokens, self.fp8, self.cache = tokens, fp8, cache
+        self.head_stride, self.row_stride = w_strides
+        self.x_stride = heads * rows if x_stride is None else x_stride
+        self.col_threads = tile // 8
+        self.threads = self.col_threads * (rows // rpt)
+        assert 32 % self.col_threads == 0 and self.threads % 32 == 0
+        assert self.threads <= 1024 and cache // 8 <= self.threads
+        self.warps = self.threads // 32
+        self.tiles = cols // tile
+        self.ctas = heads * self.tiles + (tokens if cache else 0)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self, w: cute.Tensor, x: cute.Tensor, out: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor, kv: cute.Tensor, cache: cute.Tensor,
+        slots: cute.Tensor, k_scale: cute.Tensor, block_size: Int32,
+        block_stride: Int64, entry_stride: Int64, n_slots: Int32,
+        st: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        self.kernel(
+            w, x, out, scale, kv, cache, slots, k_scale, block_size, block_stride,
+            entry_stride, n_slots,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(self.ctas, 1, 1),
+            block=(self.threads, 1, 1),
+            stream=st,
+            use_pdl=True,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self, w: cute.Tensor, x: cute.Tensor, out: cute.Tensor,
+        scale: cute.Tensor, kv: cute.Tensor, cache: cute.Tensor,
+        slots: cute.Tensor, k_scale: cute.Tensor, block_size: Int32,
+        block_stride: Int64, entry_stride: Int64, n_slots: Int32,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        smem = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator()
+        partial = alloc(smem, Float32, (self.warps, self.tokens, self.tile))
+        if block < self.heads * self.tiles:
+            self.gemv(w, x, out, scale, partial, tid, block)
+        else:
+            self.write_cache(
+                kv, cache, slots, k_scale, block_size, block_stride, entry_stride,
+                n_slots, tid, block - self.heads * self.tiles,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def write_cache(
+        self, kv, cache, slots, k_scale, block_size, block_stride, entry_stride,
+        n_slots, tid, t,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        # Rows past the slot mapping (CUDA graph padding) are not written.
+        slot = Int64(-1)
+        if t < n_slots:
+            slot = Int64(slots[t])
+        if tid < self.cache // 8 and slot >= 0:
+            got = load_words(
+                kv.iterator + t * self.cache + tid * 8,
+                count=4, word_type="u32", mutable=True,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            scale = k_scale[0]
+            v = []
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                lo, hi = unpack_bf16(got[i])
+                v += [div_rn(lo, scale), div_rn(hi, scale)]
+            block = slot // Int64(block_size)
+            offset = slot - block * Int64(block_size)
+            address = cache.iterator + block * block_stride
+            address = address + offset * entry_stride + tid * 8
+            store_words(address, (pack_fp8(tuple(v[:4])), pack_fp8(tuple(v[4:]))))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def gemv(self, w, x, out, scale, partial, tid, block):
+        warp = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        h = block // self.tiles
+        col = block % self.tiles * self.tile + tid % self.col_threads * 8
+        row = tid // self.col_threads * self.rpt
+        b = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((self.rpt, 4)), Uint32)
+        base = Int64(h) * self.head_stride + col
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rpt):
+            got = load_vector(
+                w.iterator + base + Int64(row + r) * self.row_stride, cache="weight"
+            )
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                b[r, i] = got[i]
+        inverse = Float32(1.0)
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        # Dependents read the outputs only after their own wait.
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(self.fp8):
+            inverse = div_rn(Float32(1.0), scale[0])
+
+        weights = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((self.rpt, 8)), Float32)
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rpt):
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                weights[r, 2 * i], weights[r, 2 * i + 1] = unpack_bf16(b[r, i])
+        acc = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((self.tokens, 8)), Float32)
+        acc.fill(0.0)
+        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tokens):
+            a = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout((self.rpt,)), Float32)
+            for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rpt // 8):
+                got = load_words(
+                    x.iterator + t * self.x_stride + h * self.rows + row + p * 8,
+                    count=4, word_type="u32", mutable=True,
+                )  # fmt: skip
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    a[p * 8 + 2 * i], a[p * 8 + 2 * i + 1] = unpack_bf16(got[i])
+            for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.rpt):
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    acc[t, k] = acc[t, k] + a[r] * weights[r, k]
+        # Row groups of a warp: lanes c, c + col_threads, ... of one column group.
+        offset = self.col_threads
+        while offset < 32:
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tokens):
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    acc[t, k] = acc[t, k] + cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                        acc[t, k], offset=offset
+                    )
+            offset *= 2
+        if lane < self.col_threads:
+            for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.tokens):
+                for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    partial[warp, t, lane * 8 + k] = acc[t, k]
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        for e in cutlass.range(tid, self.tokens * self.tile, self.threads, unroll=1):
+            t = e // self.tile
+            c = e % self.tile
+            total = Float32(0.0)
+            for v in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.warps):
+                total = total + partial[v, t, c]
+            j = block % self.tiles * self.tile + c
+            index = (t * self.heads + h) * self.cols + j
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.fp8):
+                out[index] = fp8_bits(_clamp_fp8(_round_bf16(total) * inverse))
+            else:
+                _store_bf16(out.iterator + index, total)
+
+
+# (cols per CTA, rows per thread) by (rows, cols) and tokens, from a GB300
+# sweep with the weights rotated out of L2.
+TACTICS = {
+    (256, 512): {1: (64, 8), 2: (64, 8), 4: (64, 16), 8: (64, 16)},  # absorb
+    (512, 256): {1: (64, 16), 2: (32, 16), 4: (32, 16)},  # value up
+    (128, 2048): {1: (64, 8), 2: (64, 8), 4: (64, 8), 8: (64, 8)},  # KDA g_b
+}
+
+
+def _flat(tensor):
+    """``tensor``'s storage span as a 1-D view."""
+    span = sum((n - 1) * s for n, s in zip(tensor.shape, tensor.stride())) + 1
+    return tensor.as_strided((span,), (1,))
+
+
+def head_gemv(x, weight, out, scale=None, cache=None):
+    """``out[t, h] = x[t, h] @ weight[h]`` with ``x`` [M, H, I] BF16 (any token
+    stride) and ``weight`` [H, I, J] BF16 (J contiguous); ``out`` [M, H, J] is
+    BF16, or FP8 (statically quantized by ``scale``, a one-element FP32 tensor)
+    when ``scale`` is given.
+
+    Args:
+        x: [M, H, I] BF16 activations.
+        weight: [H, I, J] BF16 weights.
+        out: [M, H, J] BF16 or FP8 output.
+        scale: the static FP8 scale of an FP8 ``out``.
+        cache: optionally (kv [M, L] BF16, kv_cache [blocks, block size, L] FP8,
+            slots int64, k_scale), written as ``concat_and_cache_mla``.
+
+    """
+    m, heads, rows = x.shape
+    _, _, cols = weight.shape
+    assert weight.shape == (heads, rows, cols) and weight.stride(2) == 1
+    assert x.stride(2) == 1 and x.stride(1) == rows and x.stride(0) % 8 == 0
+    assert out.is_contiguous() and m <= MAX_TOKENS
+    dev = x.device
+    fp8 = scale is not None
+    if fp8:
+        assert out.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        out = out.view(torch.uint8)
+    dummy = torch.empty(64, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+    scale = scale if fp8 else dummy.view(torch.float32)[:1]
+    width, ints = 0, (Int32(1), Int64(0), Int64(0), Int32(0))
+    kv_args = (dummy, dummy.view(torch.uint8), dummy.view(torch.int64)[:1], scale)
+    if cache is not None:
+        kv, kv_cache, slots, k_scale = cache
+        width = kv.shape[1]
+        assert kv.shape[0] == m and kv.is_contiguous() and kv_cache.shape[-1] == width
+        assert kv_cache.dim() == 3 and kv_cache.stride(2) == 1
+        assert slots.dim() == 1 and slots.dtype == torch.int64
+        raw = kv_cache.view(torch.uint8)
+        kv_args = (kv.view(-1), _flat(raw), slots, k_scale)
+        ints = (
+            Int32(raw.shape[1]), Int64(raw.stride(0)), Int64(raw.stride(1)),
+            Int32(min(slots.shape[0], m)),
+        )  # fmt: skip
+    tile, rpt = TACTICS.get((rows, cols), {}).get(m, (64, 8))
+    strides = (weight.stride(0), weight.stride(1))
+    args = (_flat(weight), _flat(x), out.view(-1), scale, *kv_args)
+    st = stream(dev)
+    key: tuple = ("gemv", heads, rows, cols, tile, rpt, m, strides, fp8, width)
+    key += (x.stride(0), dev.index) + tuple(t.shape for t in args)
+    if key not in _compiled:
+        kernel = _HeadGemvKernel(
+            heads, rows, cols, tile, rpt, m, strides, fp8, width, x.stride(0)
+        )
+        _compiled[key] = cute.compile(
+            kernel, *(to_cute(t, 16) for t in args), *ints,
+            st,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+    _compiled[key](*(to_cute(t, 16) for t in args), *ints, st)
+    return out
+
+
+class DsaAttentionStage:
+    """``MultiHeadLatentAttentionWrapper.forward`` of a DSA layer inside planned
+    steps of up to ``MAX_TOKENS`` tokens. Installed as the wrapper's ``forward``;
+    every other call runs the stock forward."""
+
+    def __init__(self, attention, value_up_tokens: set[int]):
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.flashinfer_mla_sparse import (
+            FlashInferMLASparseImpl,
+        )
+
+        w = attention.mla_attn
+        mla = w.mla_attn
+        impl = mla.impl
+        checks = (
+            (w.q_lora_rank is not None and w.fuse_qkv_rmsnorm, "a fused q/kv a-norm"),
+            (w.rotary_emb is None and w.qk_rope_head_dim == 0, "NoPE"),
+            (w.indexer is not None and not w.skip_topk, "its own indexer"),
+            (w.g_proj is None and not w.dcp_q_replicate, "no gate or DCP query"),
+            (isinstance(impl, FlashInferMLASparseImpl), "the TRTLLM-Gen sparse MLA"),
+            (str(mla.kv_cache_dtype) in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3"), "an FP8 KV cache"),
+            (mla.q_pad_num_heads is None and not mla.use_pcp, "no padding or PCP"),
+            (mla.hisparse_cache is None and impl.dcp_world_size == 1, "no HiSparse"),
+            (mla.W_UK_T.stride(-1) == 1, "a column-major W_UK"),
+        )
+        missing = [what for ok, what in checks if not ok]
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError("DSA attention stage needs " + ", ".join(missing))
+        self.wrapper, self.mla, self.impl = w, mla, impl
+        self.heads = w.num_heads
+        self.q_size = w.q_lora_rank
+        self.w_uk = mla.W_UK_T  # [N, P, L]
+        self.w_uv = mla.W_UV.contiguous()  # [N, L, V]
+        # Token counts whose W_UV runs as the CuTe GEMV; cuBLAS's bmm otherwise.
+        self.value_up_tokens = value_up_tokens
+        self.stock = w.forward
+        w.forward = self.forward
+
+    def supports(self, md, m: int) -> bool:
+        return (
+            m <= MAX_TOKENS
+            and md is not None
+            and md.num_actual_tokens == m
+            and md.num_decode_tokens == m
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, llama_4_scaling=None):
+        from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+        from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+        from .linear import planned
+
+        m = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        mla = self.mla
+        if not planned() or llama_4_scaling is not None:
+            return self.stock(positions, hidden_states, llama_4_scaling)
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        md = context.attn_metadata[mla.layer_name]
+        if not self.supports(md, m):
+            return self.stock(positions, hidden_states, llama_4_scaling)
+        w = self.wrapper
+        qkv = w.fused_qkv_a_proj(hidden_states)[0]
+        q_c, kv_c = norm(
+            qkv,
+            w.q_a_layernorm.weight.data,
+            w.kv_a_layernorm.weight.data,
+            w.q_a_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+            self.q_size,
+        )
+        q = w.q_b_proj(q_c)[0].view(m, self.heads, -1)
+        q_fp8 = torch.empty(
+            (m, self.heads, self.w_uk.shape[2]),
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            device=q.device,
+        )
+        cache = (kv_c, mla.kv_cache, context.slot_mapping[mla.layer_name], mla._k_scale)
+        head_gemv(q, self.w_uk, q_fp8, mla._q_scale, cache)
+        if not w.skip_topk:  # MTP draft steps 1+ reuse step 0's top-k
+            w.indexer(hidden_states, q_c, positions, w.indexer_rope_emb)
+        self.impl.record_logical_topk_ready()
+        kv_cache = mla.kv_cache.view(current_platform.fp8_dtype())
+        latent, _ = self.impl.forward_mqa(q_fp8, kv_cache, md, mla)
+        out = torch.empty(
+            (m, self.heads, self.w_uv.shape[2]), dtype=q.dtype, device=q.device
+        )
+        latent = latent.view(m, self.heads, -1)
+        if m in self.value_up_tokens:
+            head_gemv(latent, self.w_uv, out)
+        else:
+            torch.bmm(latent.transpose(0, 1), mla.W_UV, out=out.transpose(0, 1))
+        return w.o_proj(out.view(m, -1))[0]

+"""Skinny BF16 projections for decode steps: the CuTe skinny GEMM that issues its
+static weight loads before the PDL wait at 1-4 tokens, and Kimi K3's split-K
+tcgen05 GEMM (cluster DSMEM reduction, evict-first weight TMA) for the DSA and
+MTP draft projections at 4-64 tokens.
+
+The main model keeps cuBLAS at 8+ tokens on the KDA projections: the skinny
+GEMM falls behind it there, and the split-K tactics measured slower on the KDA
+in_proj at B4/B8 (14.4 vs 10.7 us). The DSA projections take the split-K GEMM
+at 4-64 tokens where their shape has a tactic (policy ``dsa_proj``).
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.skinny_gemm import (
+    SkinnyGemmConfig,
+    shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm,
+)
+
+# (block size, outputs per block, K unroll) per token count, by weight (N, K),
+# from a GB300 sweep with the weights rotated out of L2.
+TACTICS = {
+    (6416, 4096): {1: (64, 4, 2), 2: (64, 8, 2), 4: (64, 8, 2)},  # KDA in_proj
+    (4096, 2048): {1: (64, 8, 2), 2: (128, 4, 2), 4: (64, 8, 2)},  # KDA o_proj
+    (4096, 4096): {1: (64, 4, 2), 2: (128, 2, 1), 4: (64, 2, 2)},  # DSA o_proj
+    (4096, 8192): {1: (128, 4, 2), 2: (128, 4, 2)},  # MTP eh_proj
+    (38720, 4096): {1: (128, 2, 1), 2: (128, 2, 1)},  # MTP LM head shard
+}
+DEFAULT = {1: (64, 4, 2), 2: (64, 8, 2), 4: (64, 8, 2)}
+
+# Split-K (N tile, token tile, K split, stages) by weight (N, K) and token tile,
+# from the same sweep (us, cuBLAS -> split-K, at each tile's token count). Token
+# counts a shape has no tile for keep cuBLAS.
+SPLIT_K = {
+    # MTP LM head shard: 8 51.6 -> 46.7, 16 51.9 -> 46.9, 64 53.8 -> 48.9
+    (38720, 4096): {8: (128, 8, 1, 4), 16: (128, 16, 1, 4), 64: (128, 64, 1, 4)},
+    # MTP eh_proj: 8 13.5 -> 11.3, 16 13.6 -> 11.6, 32 13.9 -> 11.7, 64 14.2 -> 13.2
+    (4096, 8192): {
+        8: (128, 8, 4, 6),
+        16: (64, 16, 2, 10),
+        32: (64, 32, 2, 8),
+        64: (64, 64, 2, 6),
+    },
+    # DSA fused_qkv_a_proj: 8 6.5 -> 4.1, 16 8.3 -> 4.3, 32 7.5 -> 4.8, 64 7.4 -> 6.3
+    (2048, 4096): {
+        8: (64, 8, 4, 8),
+        16: (64, 16, 4, 6),
+        32: (64, 32, 2, 8),
+        64: (64, 64, 2, 6),
+    },
+    # DSA q_b_proj and indexer wq_b: 8 5.2 -> 3.2, 16 4.0 -> 3.4, 32 4.0 -> 4.0
+    (4096, 1536): {8: (64, 8, 2, 6), 16: (128, 16, 2, 6), 32: (64, 32, 2, 8)},
+    # DSA o_proj: 8 9.0 -> 6.6, 16 10.9 -> 6.7, 32 8.9 -> 7.1
+    (4096, 4096): {8: (64, 8, 2, 8), 16: (64, 16, 2, 10), 32: (64, 32, 2, 8)},
+}
+
+
+class Projection:
+    """``x @ weight.T`` for 1, 2 or 4 tokens; ``split_k_tokens`` take the split-K
+    GEMM instead where their token tile has a tactic."""
+
+    def __init__(self, weight, split_k_tokens=()):
+        self.weight = weight
+        n, k = weight.shape
+        self.configs = {}
+        for m, (block, outputs, unroll) in TACTICS.get((n, k), DEFAULT).items():
+            if k % (block * 8) or n % outputs:
+                continue
+            cfg = SkinnyGemmConfig(m, block, outputs, unroll, 8, k)
+            shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(weight.new_zeros(m, k), weight, cfg, None)
+            self.configs[m] = cfg  # compiled before capture
+        tactics = SPLIT_K.get((n, k), {})
+        policies = {}
+        for m in split_k_tokens:
+            tile = next((t for t in sorted(tactics) if t >= m), None)
+            if tile is not None:
+                policies[m] = tactics[tile]
+        self.split_k = None
+        if policies:
+            from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.gemm.projection import (  # noqa: E501
+                PreparedProjection,
+            )
+
+            self.split_k = PreparedProjection(weight, policies).prepare()
+
+    def supports(self, tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return tokens in self.configs or (
+            self.split_k is not None and tokens in self.split_k.kernels
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        m = x.shape[0]
+        if self.split_k is not None and m in self.split_k.kernels:
+            out = x.new_empty((m, self.weight.shape[0]))
+            return self.split_k.run(x, out)
+        return shape_dynamic_skinny_gemm(x, self.weight, self.configs[m], None)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Routed experts plus the shared expert of 8-64 decode tokens as one persistent
+kernel, grouped by expert, on the TRTLLM-Gen FP8 weights (see ``mega_moe``).
+
+One CTA per SM. CTA ``t`` routes and quantizes token ``t`` into a global plan;
+every CTA then cuts the routes into units of up to 16 tokens of one expert (the
+shared expert's first, then the routed experts in expert order), and splits the
+weight stages (two 128 x 128 K blocks of one row tile) evenly over the CTAs:
+
+- FC1: the stages of every unit (4 pairs of an up and a gate row tile) in one
+  list, cut into one contiguous range per CTA. A pair cut between CTAs is
+  finished by its owner, the CTA holding its first stage, which reaches it at
+  the end of its range: the others publish FP32 partials as they start theirs.
+  The owner sums them in CTA order, applies the clamped SwiGLU, quantizes the
+  hidden block to FP8 per 128 and publishes it.
+- FC2: (unit, output row tile) jobs, claimed in chunks from a counter as each
+  CTA's FC1 ends (so the CTAs that finish FC1 first take more); a job waits
+  for its unit's four hidden blocks and writes each route's BF16 output row
+  (finalize-ready, like ``mega_moe``).
+
+Above 40 units both lists are cut in halves A and B and every CTA runs FC1(A),
+FC1(B), FC2(A), FC2(B), so FC2(A)'s hidden blocks are ready by the time it runs.
+
+Block scales are not powers of two, so each K block lands in its own TMEM column
+group (the unit's tokens on the UMMA N side) and the epilogue scales (weight
+block scale times the token's activation scale, which the B gatherer warps
+compute beside the B tiles) and sums them in FP32. The weight producer posts a
+packed descriptor of every stage to the other roles through a shared memory
+ring, so a stage costs each a few shared memory loads.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint8, Uint32, Uint64
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+    stream,
+    to_cute,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.primitives import (
+    acquire_tensormap_asm,
+    alloc,
+    asm,
+    bf16x2,
+    bits_float,
+    copy_g2s,
+    div_rn,
+    fence_tmem,
+    float_bits,
+    load_bf16x8,
+    load_tma3,
+    load_tmem,
+    named_barrier,
+    pack_fp8,
+    prefetch_bytes,
+    redux,
+    release_tmem,
+    sigmoid,
+    smem_desc,
+    store_words,
+    view,
+    wait,
+    wait_tmem,
+)
+
+from .mega_moe import (
+    FP8_MAX,
+    STAGE_BYTES,
+    TILE,
+    _commit,
+    _logical_rows,
+    _ordered,
+    _store_bf16,
+    _weight_map,
+)
+
+GROUP = 16  # tokens per UMMA column group
+END = 0xFFFFFFFF  # stage descriptor past a CTA's last stage
+DEPTH = 2  # K blocks per pipeline stage, each its own TMEM column group
+MAX_TOKENS = 64
+SMEM_LIMIT = 227 * 1024
+TMEM_COLUMNS = 512
+GATHERERS = 2  # B gatherer warps, taking alternate stages
+EPILOGUE = 2 + GATHERERS  # first of the four epilogue warps
+THREADS = 32 * (EPILOGUE + 4)  # weight producer, MMA, gatherers, epilogue
+# Units above which FC1 and FC2 run as halves A and B.
+SPLIT_UNITS = 40
+# UMMA instruction: D FP32, A and B E4M3, both K-major, N = 16, M = 128.
+IDESC = (1 << 4) | ((GROUP >> 3) << 17) | ((TILE >> 4) << 24)
+# Shared CTA scalars (Int32 words).
+(
+    S_PARITY, S_UNITS, S_SPLIT, S_N1A, S_N1B, S_N2A, S_N2B,
+    S_LO1A, S_LO1B, S_J2A, S_J2B, S_S1A, S_S1B, S_FLAG,
+) = range(14)  # fmt: skip
+
+
+@asm()
+def _umma(d, a, b, instruction):
+    """Four K32 FP8 UMMAs of one 128-K block into ``d`` (the first overwrites)
+    from the elected lane."""
+    mma = "tcgen05.mma.cta_group::1.kind::f8f6f4"
+    code = "{ .reg .pred e,pf,pt; .reg .b64 a1,a2,a3,b1,b2,b3; "
+    code += "elect.sync _|e,0xffffffff; setp.eq.b32 pf,0,1; setp.eq.b32 pt,0,0; "
+    code += "add.s64 a1,$1,2; add.s64 a2,$1,4; add.s64 a3,$1,6; "
+    code += "add.s64 b1,$2,2; add.s64 b2,$2,4; add.s64 b3,$2,6; "
+    code += f"@e {mma} [$0],$1,$2,$3,pf; @e {mma} [$0],a1,b1,$3,pt; "
+    code += f"@e {mma} [$0],a2,b2,$3,pt; @e {mma} [$0],a3,b3,$3,pt; }}"
+    operands = (Uint32(d), Uint64(a), Uint64(b), Uint32(instruction))
+    return code, "r,l,l,r", operands
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def _atomic_add(pointer, value):
+    return "atom.add.acq_rel.gpu.global.u32 $0,[$1],$2;", "=r,l,r", (pointer, value)
+
+
+@asm()
+def _red_add(pointer, value):
+    return "red.relaxed.gpu.global.add.u32 [$0],$1;", "l,r", (pointer, value)
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def _atomic_inc(pointer, limit):
+    """``old >= limit ? 0 : old + 1``; returns ``old``."""
+    return "atom.inc.relaxed.gpu.global.u32 $0,[$1],$2;", "=r,l,r", (pointer, limit)
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def _load_acquire(pointer):
+    return "ld.acquire.gpu.global.b32 $0,[$1];", "=r,l", (pointer,)
+
+
+@asm(Uint32)
+def _load_l2_u32(pointer):
+    return "ld.global.cg.b32 $0,[$1];", "=r,l", (pointer,)
+
+
+@asm()
+def _fence():
+    return "fence.acq_rel.gpu;", "~{memory}", ()
+
+
+@asm(Float32)
+def _load_l2(pointer):
+    return "ld.global.cg.f32 $0,[$1];", "=f,l", (pointer,)
+
+
+@asm(Float32, pure=True)
+def _load_nc(pointer):
+    return "ld.global.nc.f32 $0,[$1];", "=f,l", (pointer,)
+
+
+@asm()
+def _store_u32(pointer, value):
+    return "st.global.b32 [$0],$1;", "l,r", (pointer, Uint32(value))
+
+
+@asm()
+def _store_f32(pointer, value):
+    return "st.global.f32 [$0],$1;", "l,f", (pointer, value)
+
+
+@asm()
+def _store_u8(pointer, value):
+    return "st.global.u8 [$0],$1;", "l,r", (pointer, Uint32(value))
+
+
+@asm(Uint32, pure=True)
+def _popc(value):
+    return "popc.b32 $0,$1;", "=r,r", (Uint32(value),)
+
+
+def unit_capacity(experts: int, top_k: int, tokens: int = MAX_TOKENS) -> int:
+    """Most units of a call: the shared expert's, then one per started GROUP of
+    each routed expert's tokens."""
+    routes = tokens * top_k
+    return -(-tokens // GROUP) + min(routes, experts) + routes // GROUP
+
+
+def counter_words(experts: int, top_k: int, pairs: int) -> int:
+    """Counters of one call parity: ready tokens, pair arrivals, unit readiness,
+    the next FC2 job of halves A and B, finished CTAs."""
+    return 4 + unit_capacity(experts, top_k) * (pairs + 1)
+
+
+class _GroupedKernel:
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, hidden, inter, experts, top_k, limit, scale, ue8m0, tokens, grid,
+        finalize,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        assert tokens <= MAX_TOKENS and experts % 32 == 0
+        self.hidden, self.inter, self.experts = hidden, inter, experts
+        self.top_k, self.limit, self.scale, self.ue8m0 = top_k, limit, scale, ue8m0
+        self.tokens, self.grid, self.finalize = tokens, grid, finalize
+        self.nk1, self.nk2 = hidden // TILE, inter // TILE
+        self.pairs = self.nk2
+        self.tiles2 = hidden // TILE
+        self.span = 2 * self.nk1 // DEPTH  # FC1 stages of a pair (up, gate)
+        self.unit1 = self.pairs * self.span  # FC1 stages of a unit
+        self.job = self.nk2 // DEPTH  # FC2 stages of a (unit, row tile) job
+        # FC2 jobs per claim: fewer unit switches against a finer tail balance
+        # (8 tokens 59 vs 65 us at 2 vs 8; 64 tokens 174 vs 181 at 8 vs 2).
+        self.chunk = 2 if tokens <= 16 else 8
+        # Units of up to GROUP tokens: one UMMA column group, accumulators in
+        # registers. Experts with more tokens run as several units.
+        self.groups = 1
+        self.width = w = GROUP
+        self.routes = tokens * top_k
+        self.shared_units = -(-tokens // GROUP)
+        self.max_units = unit_capacity(experts, top_k, tokens)
+        self.columns = DEPTH * w  # TMEM columns of a stage
+        self.slots = min(32, TMEM_COLUMNS // self.columns)
+        self.b_bytes = DEPTH * w * TILE
+        self.a_bytes = DEPTH * STAGE_BYTES
+        # As many weight stages as shared memory holds.
+        for stages in range(12, 3, -1):
+            self.layout(stages)
+            if self.smem + 1024 <= SMEM_LIMIT:
+                break
+        assert self.smem + 1024 <= SMEM_LIMIT
+
+    def layout(self, stages):
+        w, experts, tokens = self.width, self.experts, self.tokens
+        offset = 0
+
+        def take(size, align=16):
+            nonlocal offset
+            offset = (offset + align - 1) // align * align
+            start = offset
+            offset += size
+            return start
+
+        self.stages = stages
+        # Column scales of the stages in flight (see ``gather``).
+        self.ring = self.slots + stages + 1
+        # Stage descriptors: the producer posts one before waiting for its weight
+        # slot, and the epilogue reads it up to ``stages + slots`` stages later.
+        self.posts = self.slots + stages + 2
+        self.off_w = take(stages * self.a_bytes, 1024)
+        self.off_b = take(stages * self.b_bytes, 1024)
+        self.off_ring = take(self.ring * self.columns * 4)
+        self.off_hs = take(GATHERERS * w * self.nk2 * 4)
+        self.off_amax = take(4 * w * 4)
+        self.off_picks = take(self.routes * 4)
+        self.off_mask = take(experts * 8)
+        self.off_eoff = take(experts * 4)
+        self.off_uexp = take(self.max_units * 4)
+        self.off_uoff = take(self.max_units * 4 + 4)
+        self.off_ucnt = take(self.max_units * 4)
+        self.off_flat = take((self.routes + tokens) * 4)
+        self.off_scal = take(64)
+        self.off_desc = take(self.posts * 4)
+        self.bars = 2 * stages + 2 * self.slots + self.posts
+        self.off_bar = take(self.bars * 8, 8)
+        self.off_tmem = take(16)
+        self.smem = offset
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self, maps: cute.Tensor, w13_scale: cute.Tensor, w2_scale: cute.Tensor,
+        s13_scale: cute.Tensor, s2_scale: cute.Tensor, s13: cute.Tensor,
+        s2: cute.Tensor, x: cute.Tensor, logits: cute.Tensor, bias: cute.Tensor,
+        rows: cute.Tensor, out: cute.Tensor,
+        shared_out: cute.Tensor, final: cute.Tensor, ids: cute.Tensor,
+        weights: cute.Tensor, plan_x: cute.Tensor, plan_s: cute.Tensor,
+        hidden: cute.Tensor, hscale: cute.Tensor, partial: cute.Tensor,
+        counters: cute.Tensor, st: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):  # fmt: skip
+        self.kernel(
+            maps,
+            w13_scale,
+            w2_scale,
+            s13_scale,
+            s2_scale,
+            s13,

+            logits,
+            bias,

+            counters,
+        ).launch(  # fmt: skip
